findings.location: Fourth prose paragraph, second sentence, beginning “If the isotopies in the definition…”
findings.evidence: The prose calls the rigid 2π rotation a nontrivial isotopy class with identity endpoint. The rotation path ends at the identity homeomorphism; the assigned counterexample instead proves that the nontrivial boundary-fixed mapping class is f = P₁⁻¹, with δ([ρ₋]) = [f], and separately constructs a setwise-boundary isotopy from the identity to f. The summary conflates the configuration-loop class with its lifted mapping-class endpoint.
